title: Parallel III
excerpt: Update of the Parallel router module, for Orac 2.0 (Organelle), that includes a custom mix...
content:
Update of the Parallel router module, for Orac 2.0 (Organelle), that includes a custom mix page with VU-meters, 2 post-modules (P1 & P2) instead of 1 pre + 1 post, and a simpler layout for chain gain/pan pages, with minor UI improvements. 

default mix page (aux) :

knob1 : chain A (module A3) output volume
knob2 : chain B (module B4) output volume
knob3 : chain C (module C3) output volume

chains (A+B+C) -> module P1 -> module P2 -> audio out

#1 : copy parallel3_4-0.zop into /Patches
#2 : reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 : run “Install parallel3_4-0.zop”

v4.1 : minor UI improvements (mix page)

v4.0 : folder/module renamed back to "parallel3" (i'm sorry this name thing in 3.9 wasn't a good idea)

v3.9 now renamed and installed into /media/orac/usermodules/router to automatically replace the original one without overwriting it, with minor UI improvements

v3.8 : knobs control feedback added on the mix page
